title: How each tool works
subtitle: A detailed look at what happens behind the scenes when you process a file.

merge.title: Merge PDF
merge.whatItDoes: Takes two or more PDF files and combines them into a single document. Pages are joined in the order you specify: you can drag to reorder them before merging. No quality loss or reprocessing.
steps: You upload multiple PDF files via drag-and-drop or by using the file picker.
pdf-lib reads the page tree of each file and copies the pages into a new document, entirely within your browser.
The merged PDF is generated and downloaded. Your files are never uploaded to any server.

split.title: Split PDF
split.whatItDoes: Loads a PDF and renders visual previews of each page using pdf.js. You select the pages you want to extract, and pdf-lib creates a new PDF containing only those pages.
steps: pdf.js (Mozilla) renders each page as a canvas thumbnail within your browser; this is only for visual preview, not for manipulation.
You click on the pages you wish to keep. Selections are stored as an array of page indices.
pdf-lib copies only the selected pages from the original PDF into a new document, which is then downloaded.

ocr.title: OCR PDF
ocr.whatItDoes: Takes a scanned PDF (essentially images of pages) and runs optical character recognition to add a searchable text layer. The result looks the same, but you can now select, search, and copy text.
steps: Your PDF is uploaded to our server via a secure connection and placed in a processing queue.
PyMuPDF renders each page as a high-resolution image. pytesseract analyzes each image and extracts text with positioning data.
The recognized text is embedded as an invisible layer over the original PDF images. The file is then returned and automatically deleted.

pdfToWord.title: PDF to Word
pdfToWord.whatItDoes: Converts a PDF into an editable .docx file. It preserves paragraphs, headings, tables, and basic formatting. Works best with digitally created PDFs.
steps: The PDF is uploaded to the server and queued for asynchronous processing.
pdf2docx analyzes the internal structure of the PDF—text blocks, fonts, spacing, and tables—and converts them into Word document elements.
A .docx file is generated and returned for download. The file on the server is deleted after delivery.
pdfToWord.warning: pdf2docx works with native or digital PDFs. If your PDF is a scanned image, run OCR first and then convert it. The tool cannot extract text directly from images.

imageToPdf.title: Image to PDF
imageToPdf.whatItDoes: Converts one or more images (JPG, PNG, WebP) into a PDF document. Each image becomes a full page. You can also combine multiple images into a multi-page PDF.
steps: Images are loaded into the browser. HTML5 Canvas reads the dimensions of each image and converts it into bytes.
pdf-lib creates a new page with the aspect ratio of each image and embeds the data directly into the PDF.
The resulting PDF is generated and downloaded. Everything stays in your browser, without uploading anything to the server.
